name: Tata Motors
description: Tata Motors demerged effective Oct 1, 2025 into two listed entities: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (TMPV) and Tata Motors Ltd, the commercial-vehicle entity (listed Nov 12, 2025). Figures below are FY25 consolidated (pre-demerger) unless noted.

stock.note: Post-demerger CV entity (Tata Motors Ltd); listed at ₹335 on Nov 12, 2025, ~₹458-460 by Jan 30, 2026. PV entity (TMPV) traded ~₹350 (unlisted-market quote, Jan 30, 2026). Freshest available quotes are ~Jan 2026 — recommend a live refresh.

marketing_spend.derivation: A specific FY25 advertising/sales-promotion line was not located in the FY25 'Other expenses' note in aggregator snippets (recommend pulling the annual-report PDF directly).
